verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Elicit API that can be called from "your own code, scripts, and workflows", plus an MCP server. Neither is an official SDK or client library, and nothing in the pack names a language-specific package for building against Elicit. A raw API and an MCP endpoint are adjacent capabilities that do not transfer to an SDK story, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
